---
name: Build or data correction
about: A build, number, talent description, or drop location is wrong or outdated
title: "[Correction] "
labels: content
---

**Section**
Which section is this about? (e.g. Best PvE Builds, Weapon Tier List, Glossary…)

**What's listed now**
Quote or describe the current entry.

**What it should say**
What's actually correct, ideally with a source (patch notes, in-game tooltip, etc.).

**Season / patch this applies to**
So we can tell if this is still current by the time it's reviewed.
